Hey there girls and guys,

notes.title: Back to the older Version
notes.notes:
Hey there girls and guys.

Implementing the voxel system seems to be a thing one man should not work on.

Every time I fix something 2 other issues will follow and I feel like I am loosing time in a never ending loop. So I decided to roll back to the version before the voxel mess and keep working further on this version.

This means the next updates will be content updates and map editing will be gone. But it means your current savegames will not work properly.... Again. Sorry about that and sorry to the people that bought the game just because voxel based maps were in the game.


I hope you can understand the descision. I want to provide a working game and not something that constantly crashes.

notes.title: Minor changes that will change the game
notes.notes:
Hey there girls and guys.

I guess we need to talk. In the last few month I changed a lot because of whished that were made by the community. Some of them were absolutely great and some were not that good.

I want to talk about the changes that were not that good. There are more points so I will list them and tell you what will be changed on them. I know some of you will not like it but I talked to 2 of my nearest testers that told me I have messed up the game with the changes and I absolutely agree with them. So sorry if you may not like the upcomming changes but they have to be made to make the gameplay much more progress based and interesting.

So here are the points and its changes for the next big update:

- [b]Learning Blueprints[/b] | Collecting fragments to learn the blueprints and finding one of the shrines is more frustrating than interesting. It will be changed to a find and learn system. There will be 2 ways of learning blueprints: Collect resources and the research table will be used for unlocking new blueprints via placing resources into it and It will show you possible blueprints with the resources you placed inside of it. If you place all needed resources into the research table you will be able to learn the blueprint.

- [b]Mining resources like copper, iron, coal etc.[/b] | Finding thoseresources everywhere is less challenging and too easy to get everything in no time. This makes it way too easy. It will be changed to the fact that those resources will only be collectable in cavesm which makes much more sense.

- [b]Enemies all over the map[/b] | The fact that enemies are all over the map does not make sense like it is now. It will be changed to spot behaved monster spawns. Means that harder monsters will be present in caves and normal monsters will be present in the forts and other specific points on the map. This will not include the animals because they are wild animals and it makes sense that you can find them like they are now.

- [b]Energy[/b] | The fact that you hit 2 times with a greathammer and your energy is empty is frustrating for most players and I agree with that. It will be changed to a system where your energy is like a resource that will slowly drain with the actions you made. Like it is in real life. You getting more tired the more you do on a day. The energy can be regained by sleeping, resting at fireplaces or eating meals.

- [b]Mounts[/b] | At this moment you simply use a lasso, do a minigame and you tamed the animal to use it as a mount. Absolutely lame and not beneficial. This will be changed to the system that was in the game one year ago. That means you have to unlock access to a mount that can not die and can be spawned to ride on directly by summon it. To unlock them you have to collect items and sacrifice it to the holy tree spirit that can be found at the feet of the great tree in the green lands. This is much more beneficial and offers the player the possibility to work for something that is really nice.

- [b]Something to do[/b] | At this moment there is not much to do. The description of the game says "Build on what was once and defend it with your life" but nothing in the game shows this. So I decided to reimplement rebuilding logics for Villages that have to be rebuilded. This means a minimum of one village for each biome. Benefit for it: Special events where you can save a live of a villager that is in danger, will send the villager to one of the villages which unlocks shops and other useful thing. This villages will be safe zones for dedicated server games but you have to defend this villages from monster attacks that will be random but only on one village at a time will be attacked. Means this is a constant mission in the game which was planned for the game since the very beginning.

- [b]How to play Questline[/b] | At this moment you start the game with a questline that guides you through the mechanics of the game. This questline will be deleted because of the fact that most of the players ignoring it. But In replace I will add pop up messages for stuff you are doing the first time and a journal where you can read about every mechanic that will teach you things you may want to know.


I know some of you will not agree with this points and maybe you will never play the game again. But making this descision is more than important.

Thank you for all of your support, bug posts and everything you have to share. Your voice is always important but sometimes I have to hear to my own thoughts and I think this is the right way of doing it now.

notes.title: Dedicated Server and Default branch changes
notes.notes:
Hi there. I hope you are well and healthy in these days.


I know the last information about Re.Poly is a couple of weeks ago but I'm working on
stuff, that I can't test with the default branch of the game.

Because of the changes for dedicated servers, the story mode will be deleted and the quest system is deleted too. This is a change that is been made, because I changed the roadmap.

The story so war wasn't very long and it made no sense, so I decided to change the core of the game to a pvp based game wich has a story behind the scenes. There will be a story but it will be telled in a different way.

To give the game a unique touch I have many ideas. To name some of it I will reveal some of them:

- Quest making: You can define quests for others. So if you need something to do and don't want to do it on your own, you will have the possibility to define quests for other players. They get experience for complete your quests and if you want, you can set items that you can offer too.

- Portal rebuilding: You can rebuild portals, that give you a better mobility

- Town rebuilding: You can rebuild towns. After a town is rebuilded, there will be a save zone and you can trade there.

- Trading: If a town is rebuilded, you have access to a marketplace where players can sell items

- Raiding: You can raid the base of an other player

- Attacking and defending possibilities: There will be a variety of base defending and base attacking possibilities

and many more.


At this moment I'm waiting for a response from a big serverhoster. I want to give you the possibility to host your own servers.


If you want to test what I'm working on, just go ahead into the steam settings of Re.Poly and change in the "Betas" - Tab to experimental. There you have access to the new version of the game that is a bit unstable at this moment but it works.


Stay healthy and thank you for your support

notes.title: A lot of stuff and changes will come

Hi there. I'm working on a lot of stuff right now and I want to show you some of the things that I have finished. I know you are waiting for the next update but trust me, It is neccessary to do it like this.


[h2]Base Building[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35365906/0ecbc0e43754f4a5f84fe83e107a476175203460.png[/img]

Because of the fact that PVP will be active in the new update and you can play on dedicated servers, it is important that you can build a base as soon as possible. So I decided to create twig build parts that you can build until you are Lvl 5. You can upgrade them to wood or if you are higher lvl build them in the workbench. It is up to you how you will handle this. Upgrading will have less resource cost than building it in the workbench.


[h2]Iron Armor and Weapons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35365906/45607673944db9125258b802d713a4f3b8c6aa40.png[/img]

You can find iron in the Dark Forest. Forge it to iron ingots and craft armor and weapons.
They will have more armor than copper and more damage than copper obviously.


[h2]New Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35365906/d17fb0fd7f9ed5c3a412c3db898a2428f0db4217.png[/img]

There will be a new map called "Valuntera"
This map is designed for the dedicated servers and will not have a linear story at the start.
Later on you can find a lot of stuff that will explain the story in another way than the single player mode.


You see, I'm still working hard on this. I know this take some time but it will be great until I finished the work on this update.

If I fixed the problems earlier, the game will be released earlier.

You can get any informations about the progress on the Re.Poly Discord: https://discord.gg/QbGKXJe

Again I'm apologizing, but I dont want to hand you a game that is not working properly. You payed for this game, so I will give you a working product.
